payload.body: A WP03 contract question from dc's WP05 doc check, your call, not urgent: the ops and docs profiles deny credential reads through Read() rules only, which bind Claude Code's Read tool and not sandboxed Bash. Claude Code's docs say a project settings.json may also carry sandbox.credentials.files entries, eg {"path":"~/.ssh","mode":"deny"} and {"path":"~/.aws/credentials","mode":"deny"}, and that these merge from the project scope (mask entries are dropped from project scope; deny entries are not). Adding them to ops and docs would make their sandboxed Bash unable to read those files too, before WP06's managed floor. It is untested: dc and I would test it with a scratch CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR before any sleeve relies on it. Yes (vc specifies, dc adds to Molt-matts roles, tested first) or no (leave to WP06)?
